title: Exploration of Potential miRNA Biomarkers and Prediction for Ovarian Cancer Using Artificial Intelligence.
summary: ML feature selection identifies ovarian-cancer-associated miRNA features, with a held-out test set and reported classification performance. This is a disease-specific diagnostic prediction result on a transcriptomic dataset, not evidence of clinical screening benefit.
